limits: Sealed epoch-04 saved predictions and dataset GT only. This is CPU trajectory diagnosis, not a NN replay, text-content intervention, module causality test, full-nine audit or training-time input. Invalid GT does not prove physical absence. Crop centres are reconstructed from saved previous boxes with native factor4 geometry. Segment onset need not be the first causal divergence. All-box R is a fixed-trajectory recall upper bound for confidence-only changes, not a deployable P/F gain.
